lines.text: Why are most homes across the United States built out of wood instead of brick or concrete?
It is not because of cheap construction; it comes down to geography, efficiency, and engineering.
North America is home to vast sustainable forests, making structural lumber abundant and renewable.
Light-frame wood construction allows a crew to frame an entire house in just a few days.
Wood also offers incredible thermal insulation and flexibility, making it far safer in earthquake zones.
Modifying walls to run modern plumbing, electrical wiring, and HVAC ducts is infinitely easier in wood.
Wood framing made spacious, affordable housing possible for millions of American families.
